name: 新しいグループの会話開始カード
prompt:
Edit generated v001 so the full composition exactly matches the first reference image, the native 390 × 354 px Japanese preview. The second reference is v001 and shows the geometry to correct; the third source crop is only for meaning. Preserve the exact Japanese copy and quiet mint/green palette. Keep a 390 × 354 canvas, white background, no outer padding added.

Correct the card first: the native card is x=24,y=8,w=342,h=330 with a white fill, thin #E8ECE9 border, and 12 px rounded corners. v001 starts near y=24 and is too short. Move the card top to y=8 and extend its bottom to y=338 while preserving its x position, width, and corner radius.

Use these absolute native canvas coordinates so the card contents do not drift: mint avatar circle x=164,y=24,w=62,h=62, fill #D1FAE5, with centered dark-green 「光」 in Meiryo Bold 14 px; centered title box x=40,y=116,w=310,h=28 with 「グループを作成しました」 in Meiryo Bold 20 px, line height 28, #1D1D1D; centered subtitle x=40,y=156,w=310,h=24 with 「グループ・メンバー3人」 in Meiryo Regular 14 px, line height 24, #6E6E6E; centered green action x=40,y=198,w=310,h=24 with 「説明を追加」 in Meiryo Bold 14 px, line height 24, #047857.

Button 1 must be x=40,y=244,w=310,h=32; button 2 x=40,y=290,w=310,h=32. Both have #ECFDF5 fill and 16 px corners. Center labels vertically and horizontally: 「メンバーを追加」 and 「リンクやコードで招待」 in Meiryo Regular 12 px, line height 16, #064E3B. Preserve the native 14 px gap between the two button pills and the native 16 px bottom inset to card border. Do not make either label blue or underlined: these are contained Japanese action buttons, not text hyperlinks. 「説明を追加」 is also the native green in-app action, not a hyperlink. The source chain-link icon is omitted by the Japanese native component; do not add it or any other icon. Keep exact wording. Do not add a photo, extra copy, badge, shadow, decoration, or device frame.
reviewNotes: v002 fixes the card bounds and vertical layout. User then directed no tint colors; the candidate still has pale mint fills on the avatar and both action buttons, so keep needs-correction and make a user-directed no-tint revision. The invite label remains a contained button action, not hyperlink text.
